title: A Note on a Theorem of Apter
summary: We show that the consistency of $\mathrm{ZF} + \mathrm{AD}_{\mathbb{R}} + ``Θ$ is measurable$"$ implies the consistency of $\mathrm{ZF} +``Θ$ is the least strongly regular cardinal and the least measurable cardinal$"$ + $``$all uncountable cardinals below $Θ$ are of countable cofinality$"$.
